content.short: Stablecoin-powered neobank and asset platform for emerging markets.
content.description: Fasset is a stablecoin-powered digital bank built for emerging markets, positioning itself as one of the first Islamic, fully on-chain neobanks. Serving users across the MENA region, Southeast Asia, and other emerging economies, it lets consumers and businesses hold dollar-pegged stablecoins such as USDC, make cross-border payments, and invest in tokenized and digital assets from a single app. Fasset uses stablecoins as its core settlement layer, running on its Own Network Layer 2 alongside established chains like Ethereum and Polygon to keep transactions fast and low-cost. Backed by a $51 million raise, it aims to turn stablecoins into everyday banking rails for the billions of people underserved by traditional financial institutions.
